In this week you will work with a real diabetes dataset and learn how to **prepare raw data for analysis** and **visualise distributions**. Complete all three steps below to finish the week.

### Quiz 2: Data Cleanup
<span id="quiz-done-w2_q_cleanup" class="quiz-done-badge">✓ Done</span>

```{=html}
<div class="quiz-card">
  <div class="mb-4">
    <p><strong>Question 1:</strong> <code>which(x > 5)</code> for <code>x &lt;- c(2, 8, 3, 7, 1)</code> returns…</p>
    <div class="form-check"><input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="c1" id="c1a"><label class="form-check-label" for="c1a"><code>c(8, 7)</code> — the values greater than 5</label></div>
    <div class="form-check"><input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="c1" id="c1b"><label class="form-check-label" for="c1b"><code>c(2, 4)</code> — the indices (positions) where the condition is TRUE</label></div>
    <div class="form-check"><input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="c1" id="c1c"><label class="form-check-label" for="c1c"><code>c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE)</code></label></div>
    <div class="form-check mb-2"><input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="c1" id="c1d"><label class="form-check-label" for="c1d">An error</label></div>
    <div id="c1-feedback" class="mt-1 fw-bold"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="mb-4">
    <p><strong>Question 2:</strong> How do you remove columns 3 and 7 from dataframe <code>dat</code>?</p>
    <div class="form-check"><input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="c2" id="c2a"><label class="form-check-label" for="c2a"><code>dat[-c(3,7)]</code></label></div>
    <div class="form-check"><input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="c2" id="c2b"><label class="form-check-label" for="c2b"><code>dat[, -c(3,7)]</code></label></div>
    <div class="form-check"><input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="c2" id="c2c"><label class="form-check-label" for="c2c"><code>dat[c(3,7), ]</code></label></div>
    <div class="form-check mb-2"><input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="c2" id="c2d"><label class="form-check-label" for="c2d"><code>dat - c(3,7)</code></label></div>
    <div id="c2-feedback" class="mt-1 fw-bold"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="mb-4">
    <p><strong>Question 3:</strong> <code>apply(dat, 1, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))</code> counts the NAs…</p>
    <div class="form-check"><input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="c3" id="c3a"><label class="form-check-label" for="c3a">Per column (one value per variable)</label></div>
    <div class="form-check"><input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="c3" id="c3b"><label class="form-check-label" for="c3b">Per row (one value per patient)</label></div>
    <div class="form-check"><input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="c3" id="c3c"><label class="form-check-label" for="c3c">In the entire dataframe (one total)</label></div>
    <div class="form-check mb-2"><input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="c3" id="c3d"><label class="form-check-label" for="c3d">Per cell (one value per element)</label></div>
    <div id="c3-feedback" class="mt-1 fw-bold"></div>
  </div>
  <button onclick="checkCleanupQuiz()" class="btn btn-primary w-100" style="background-color:#1a4d1a;border:none;font-weight:700;">CHECK ANSWERS</button>
  <div id="cleanup-result" class="mt-3 fw-bold text-center"></div>
</div>
```
